frozen_hyperparameters: reuse each reference fold/seed width and epoch selected using only that fold training people; no weighted retuning or test-based selection
scope: same 4..10 and 30..60 bands, 1/3/5 bouts, people, visits, folds and three draws; primary draw0
loss_weight: base equal-person visit weight multiplied by factor iff training SPPB<=3 or TUG>20, then normalize globally; not normalized again within person
thresholds: descriptive visit groups, not diagnostic categories
preprocessing: unchanged base person-weighted train-only X/y scaler; no target boost in scalers
architecture_optimizer: unchanged mean-pooled Deep Sets, full-batch AdamW lr .01 decay .001, standardized-target SmoothL1 beta .5
evaluation: unchanged equal-person visit weighting, no tail boost in metrics; all, tail, non-tail, score bands, cohorts
comparisons: paired same-seed/fold reference; report all five seeds, mean/range and MAE/bias/RMSE/p90; no best seed or ensemble
interpretation: no chosen allowable global degradation margin; quantify tradeoffs, no automatic adoption or winner selection
